description: This source file defines a Python class `SageMakerBidiClient` that implements a client for bidirectional streaming communication with AWS SageMaker endpoints using HTTP/2 protocol. It includes methods for initializing the client, starting and closing sessions, sending various data types (audio, text, JSON), and receiving streaming responses. The code handles AWS authentication, connection setup, and data flow for interacting with SageMaker models.
